summary: The 'non_gaia' version provides a professional integration of CrewAI agents with a FastAPI web interface. It handles symptom reporting and analysis with structured data (Pydantic models) and provides specific endpoints for health authorities and researchers.

findings.description: Exposes clear, documented endpoints using FastAPI, facilitating easy integration with external systems.
Uses Pydantic models to ensure strict data validation for symptom reports and analysis results.
Ready for actual LLM usage through CrewAI and LangChain integration settings.
Agent delegation is disabled, which limits the autonomous coordination potential of the CrewAI framework.
findings.evidence: allow_delegation=False in all agent definitions (e.g., symptom_reporter.py)

implementation_risks: In-memory data storage (self.health_data_store) will be lost on server restart; needs persistent database implementation.
